verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source email app, so shipping official SDKs is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The only developer-facing surface is an MCP server capability list authenticated by a copied session cookie, and an independent note says there is no public HTTP API. The MCP server belongs to a different story, and the vague 'Developer-Friendly' tagline does not show an SDK exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
